title: Leclerc storms to Monza glory as Tifosi dream of title glory
summary: Charles Leclerc held off a late charging Max Verstappen to win his second Italian Grand Prix, closing the gap to the championship leader to 90 points with seven rounds remaining.

title: Hamilton admits Ferrari title challenge is 'slipping away'
summary: The seven-time champion was candid after a difficult Monza weekend, insisting the Scuderia must 'bring upgrades that actually work' if they are to fight in 2027.

title: Verstappen bounces back with record-breaking Zandvoort win
summary: On home soil, Max Verstappen delivered a masterclass to equal the record for most consecutive Dutch Grand Prix victories, leading every lap from pole position.

title: McLaren tighten grip on Constructors' Championship after Spa thriller
summary: A double podium in Belgium gave McLaren a commanding lead over Ferrari and Red Bull, with both papaya cars showing blistering straight-line speed.

title: Rookie watch: Antonelli's wet-weather masterclass turns heads
summary: The 20-year-old Mercedes driver climbed from 14th to 5th in changeable conditions at Spa, drawing comparisons to a young Hamilton from paddock insiders.

title: F1 confirms six sprint races for expanded 2027 calendar
summary: The FIA and Formula 1 announced the 2027 calendar will feature a record 25 rounds, including six sprint weekends and the long-awaited return to a European classic.
